recipes.title: Strawberry Protein Ice Cream (Ninja Creami)

items.i: splash of almond milk, for the respin

steps: In a Creami pint, mix the milk, yogurt, protein powder and honey, then stir in the chopped strawberries.
Spin on Lite Ice Cream, add a splash of almond milk and run Mix-In.
recipes.notes: Amounts are as said in the video; 37 g protein for the pint is as stated, other macros are estimates. Freezing time not included.
